title: Edit and Preview Your App Store Listing in Bitrig
summary: See your product page as it will look on the App Store, and watch it update live as you and your agent make changes.
body_markdown:
Publishing your app can mean a lot of trips to App Store Connect, clicking through page after page to update the same fields in every language.


Bitrig already[lets you skip that](https://bitrig.com/blog/bitrig-publishes-to-the-app-store) . Your listing lives in your project, and you can push changes to App Store Connect in one click. But you couldn’t see your changes until they were live.


Today, that changes:


**You can now edit and preview your full App Store listing right in Bitrig.**


That means:


-


**Edit it all in one place.** Update the text for each platform your app ships on, in every language your listing has. If someone changed the same field in App Store Connect, Bitrig flags the conflict and lets you keep yours or use theirs.


-


**See it before it’s live.** A preview beside the fields shows your product page or search result as it will look on the App Store, with your icon and screenshots. Check it on iPhone or iPad, in light or dark mode, and in any language.


-


**Add screenshots and videos.** Drag screenshots onto your listing and Bitrig files each one under the right device size. Have the agent add app preview videos, a product page header, and search results art, and see them all in the live preview.


-


**Get ready for iPhone Duo.** Ask the agent for iPhone Duo screenshots and it captures them on the[Duo simulator](https://bitrig.com/blog/bitrig-builds-iphone-duo-apps) , at the exact sizes App Store Connect requires. Then preview how your product page looks on Duo, closed or fully open.


The App Store tab sits beside the simulator and your code, so you can work on your listing the way you work on your app. Ask the agent to rewrite your description, tweak a word yourself, and watch the preview update. When you’re ready, submit your build and listing changes together, and follow them through App Review.


iPhone Duo[arrives October 23](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/09/apple-unveils-iphone-duo/) . So open the App Store tab, add your iPhone Duo screenshots, and make sure your product page is ready on day one.
